home.title: Your controller
home.subtitle: DualPad turns your DualSense into an Xbox controller for Windows. The touchpad works as a mouse.
home.vigem.title: ViGEmBus driver missing
home.vigem.message: It is needed to create the virtual Xbox controller. Install it and restart DualPad.
home.blocked.title: The DualSense is being used by another app
home.blocked.message: DS4Windows is probably open and holding the controller exclusively. Close it to use DualPad.
home.empty.title: Connect your DualSense
home.empty.text: Plug it in with a USB-C cable or, if it is already paired over Bluetooth, press the PS button.
home.empty.pairing: First Bluetooth pairing: hold Create + PS until the light blinks, then add it from Windows Settings › Bluetooth & devices.
home.tip.title: Tip
home.tip.text: The touchpad moves the cursor: tap to click, press the right side to right-click and scroll with two fingers.
mapping.title: Buttons
mapping.subtitle: Every button starts in the matching Xbox position. Click a button on the drawing (or press it on the controller) and choose what it should do.
mapping.detect: Select by pressing the button on the controller
mapping.resetAll.confirm: Reset every button in this profile to the standard Xbox layout?
mapping.key.prompt: Click here and press a key
mapping.key.hint: The key you press will be assigned
mapping.key.listeningHint: Esc assigns Esc · click elsewhere to cancel
mapping.none.text: Pressing this button will do nothing. Handy for disabling buttons you hit by mistake.
sticks.title: Touchpad & sticks
sticks.subtitle: Tune the touchpad cursor and the dead zones of the sticks and triggers. The previews move with the controller.
sticks.touchMouse: Use the touchpad as a mouse
sticks.tap: Tap to click (two fingers = right click)
sticks.rightZone: Press the right side to right-click
sticks.curve: Response (1 = linear, higher = more precise near the center)
sticks.triggerDead: Below this threshold the trigger counts as released.
lights.title: Lights & rumble
lights.subtitle: Choose the light bar color and how strongly the controller vibrates in games.
lights.battery: Color by battery level (green, orange, red)
lights.playerLeds: Show the player number on the white LEDs
profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.subtitle: A profile holds buttons, touchpad, sticks, lights and rumble. Make one for each game and switch from the bar at the top.
profiles.delete.title: Delete profile
profiles.import.title: Import profile
profiles.import.invalid: The file is not a valid DualPad profile.
settings.title: Settings
settings.startMinimized: Start minimized to the notification area
settings.minimizeToTray: Keep running near the clock when the window is closed
settings.language.restart: Restart DualPad to apply the new language.
settings.hide.caption: Prevents double input in games that also read the PlayStation controller.
settings.hide.captionAdmin: Prevents double input in games that also read the PlayStation controller. Windows will ask for administrator permission.
settings.hide.notInstalled: HidHide is not installed: you can install it below, in Drivers and components.
settings.drivers.note: Installs use winget (the Windows package manager) and download from the official sources. Windows will ask for administrator permission; by installing you accept the components' licenses.
drivers.allInstalled: Everything is installed: DualPad has all it needs.
drivers.optionalOnly: The required components are there; you can add the optional ones.
dep.vigem.desc: Driver that creates the virtual Xbox 360 controller. Without it, games can't see the controller.
dep.vigem.after: Restart DualPad to enable the Xbox controller.
dep.dotnet.desc: The Microsoft runtime DualPad runs on. Updating it brings security and performance fixes.
dep.dotnet.after: Restart DualPad to use the new version.
dep.hidhide.desc: Hides the DualSense from games that also read it directly, so they don't get double input.
dep.hidhide.after: Restart your PC to finish installing the driver.
dep.noWinget: winget is not available, so the download page was opened.
dep.upToDate: The latest version is already installed.
advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.subtitle: Controller power, performance and latency measurement.
advanced.question: How much delay does DualPad add?
advanced.explain: During the test (10 seconds), move the sticks and press buttons. DualPad measures how often data arrives from the controller, how long it takes to process it and how long the virtual Xbox controller takes to make it readable to games (through XInput, the same path games use).
advanced.hint: Move the sticks and press buttons…
advanced.moveSticks: move the sticks during the test
advanced.verdict.great: Great: DualPad doesn't slow your controller down
advanced.verdict.added: DualPad adds about {0} between the data arriving and the game.
advanced.verdict.polling: On top of that, an input waits on average {0} for the controller's next report ({1}).
advanced.verdict.tryPriority: Try turning on high priority and closing heavy background programs.
advanced.verdict.radio: The remaining margin is in the radio link: it is lower with the USB cable.
advanced.notMeasurable: Not measurable in software: the Bluetooth radio link and the game itself. For the lowest possible latency, use the USB-C cable.
advanced.tip.bt: You are connected over Bluetooth: for even lower latency use the USB-C cable, which removes the radio link.
advanced.tip.usb: You are connected over USB: it is already the lowest-latency connection.
advanced.highPriority.caption: Windows gives DualPad precedence, so input stays on time even when the game uses all the CPU.
advanced.already1: • Dedicated highest-priority reading thread: every report is mapped and sent right away, with no timers or queues.
advanced.already2: • Driver queue kept to a minimum: stale reports are never read.
advanced.already3: • The virtual Xbox controller is only updated when something changes.
advanced.powerOffOnExit: Turn the controller off when DualPad closes
advanced.powerOffOnExit.caption: Applies to Bluetooth. Over USB the controller is powered by the cable, so it can't be turned off.
